Discover the Boothbay, a premium leather boat shoe handcrafted in Lewiston, Maine. Designed with timeless style and modern performance, this men’s boat shoe is built using Genuine Handsewn Moccasin construction—a hallmark of authentic Maine craftsmanship.
Made with soft, full-grain leather in rich Boheme Lava/Parchment Cotswold. Boheme Lava is a soft aniline, fully drum-dyed leather. The Boothbay features a fully leather-lined interior for all-day comfort. Chestnut leather laces wrap around the collar for a secure, custom fit.
A non-marking rubber outsole with siping provides reliable traction on wet and slippery surfaces—ideal for boat decks, docks, and summer adventures. Elevated design elements like the foxing backstay, lieutenant bar overcast, and detailed welting give this classic silhouette a refined edge.
Whether on the water or off the clock, the Boothbay boat shoe delivers premium quality, heritage style, and true Maine-made authenticity.
